title: Basic Hero MVP
description:
## <custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-0">:person_with_crown:</custom> User Story

As a website owner, I want a flexible hero component that can serve as both a static hero section and an interactive slider so that I can create engaging landing pages and showcase important content.

---

## <custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-1">:clipboard:</custom> Requirements

‌

### Basic Hero Functionality

* The hero component should display a full-width background image

    * Should have the possibility to choose an additional background color (as fallback and for [slider animation](https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=4633-94336&t=jjODZ2Yq8pkirQ1Z-4))
    * mobile and desktop image can be uploaded
    * can also have mobile and desktop video background
    
* The component should be responsive across all device sizes
* It should support overlaying text content 

    * Headings are obligatory
    * Sublines are optional
    * There is no max. character limit (it's up to the users how much text they want to put there, even if the layout might break etc.)
    * [Caption Flag](https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=4530-42837&t=jjODZ2Yq8pkirQ1Z-4) as internal component are optional
    
        * There can be up to 3 flags.
        * The user can choose between plain and boxed.
        * With the boxed variant, he can also select the background color. So Primary, Accent, Success, Sale etc. (Reminder: The text must be black on light colors such as yellow or lime).
        
    * Buttons
    
        * Buttons are optional. 
        * Each slide can have two buttons. 
        * Users can choose the style of each button themselves. 
        * On a light background, the primary button is the default. 
        * On a dark background it is the secondary white button.

### [Slider Functionality](https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=4763-129498&t=jjODZ2Yq8pkirQ1Z-4)

* Users can toggle between static hero and slider mode
* When in slider mode, support multiple slides with different content

    * The slider should be infinite on mobile and desktop.
    
* This [example from swiperjs](https://swiperjs.com/demos#effect-creative) was taken as a basis. 
* We won't have autoplay of the slides here for the time being. Because if we had that, we would also need a timer and the option to pause the slider via control elements.
* Include [navigation arrows and slide indicators](https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=4606-27846&t=jjODZ2Yq8pkirQ1Z-4)

    * The icon buttons are not displayed on mobile devices.
    * The number of slides is not limited.
    * If there is only one slide, there is no slider navigation.
    * The User can choose the Color of the bullets on light background (accent or primary)
    
* Allow video auto-play with configurable timing

    * display [video control](https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=4719-9825&t=jjODZ2Yq8pkirQ1Z-4) if a background video is used
    * if auto-play is on, show pause button as default

### Layout Options

* Support different content alignments _(Orientation)_

    * It should be possible to set the orientation for desktop and mobile for the entire Hero. The selected orientation then applies to each slide.  
      Example: On desktop the text should be center left, but on mobile top left etc.
    

![](blob:https://media.staging.atl-paas.net/?type=file&localId=null&id=15bcbacd-c114-45a1-9f91-0ae34752b77c&&collection=&height=34&occurrenceKey=null&width=349&__contextId=null&__displayType=null&__external=false&__fileMimeType=null&__fileName=null&__fileSize=null&__mediaTraceId=null&url=null)
### Styling Options

* Has two styles: on light and on dark background _(this is not the same as light and dark mode)_
* Background colors

    * It should be possible to select a background color for each slide. This can either be selected from the global palette, entered as a HEX value, or using a picker from the image associated with the slide.
    
        * To simplify color selection in use, only the values /3 (pale) and /9 (solid) should ever be available for selection for the global colors.
        
    
* Text colors

    * Default are the colors set in the figma component
    * MVP colors for text should be the variables colors/text
    
* Support possibility to add [color or gradient overlay](https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=4663-127427&t=jjODZ2Yq8pkirQ1Z-4)

    * Support overlay opacity
    

![](blob:https://media.staging.atl-paas.net/?type=file&localId=null&id=64f0cad2-63ae-416e-a5e8-c3f0670479a0&&collection=&height=37&occurrenceKey=null&width=353&__contextId=null&__displayType=null&__external=false&__fileMimeType=null&__fileName=null&__fileSize=null&__mediaTraceId=null&url=null)
### Accessability

* Proper accessibility features must be implemented
* Video content:

    * Since we also want to take the WCAG (1.1.1, 1.2.1, 1.2.8, 2.2.2) guidelines into account, there must be an alternative description not only for images, but also for background videos. It must also be possible to pause a background video.
    
* It would be good to have hints for laioutr users later in studio:

    * Since accessibility will be mandatory for B2C online stores from June 25, 2025, we should point out to our users that they should pay particular attention to the guidelines under 2.3 and 1.2 regarding the video material used.
